timeline.body: On November 10, 2026, from approximately 15:00 UTC to 17:55 UTC, GitHub experienced degraded performance affecting repository pages, pull requests, and GitHub Actions. Customers may have seen slow or failed page loads and delays processing pull request updates and merges. Some pull requests continued to display an earlier source-branch commit after the broader service degradation ended. GitHub Actions workflows were delayed for approximately 1.8% of events, peaking at about 7% between 16:30 and 16:50 UTC. Delays were typically 1.5 to 3.5 minutes, up to 10 minutes.
